msContents.summary: probably a spell against fever (According to: Fischer-Elfert, 170) Recto: "The half temple" or "the half death" is mentioned on the verso. Verso: A threat against the gods and a formula to protect the magician are preserved partly. "The three-day heat" is mentioned.
